context: Checkpoint 2026-07-24 (22nd). MESH ARTIFACT DISTRIBUTION v1 landed + proven live. The dev PC is now a temporary binary/build server on the tailnet: 'refarm dist publish' assembles the farm-client kit + a sha256-verified manifest.json into .refarm/dist/farm-client (gitignored artifact); 'refarm web serve <that> --host 0.0.0.0' exposes it (reused, no new server); the zero-dep 'farm-update' bin pulls only changed files, VERIFIES each sha256, stages, and swaps atomically. Proven end-to-end: farm-update pulled the 12-file kit (46 KB) into a bare dir, verified it, and the DOWNLOADED farm-ask then drove the farm and printed its usage footer — a device with only Node (no git/npm/clone) got the software over the mesh. Manifest is a neutral wire contract (path-traversal-guarded), extensible to a compiled tractor binary for an x86 peer. 3 commits pushed (08bc6003 doc, 8b4e8468 farm-client, 284673a1 dist publish); all gates green; +12 tests (9 farm-client manifest + 3 apps/refarm).
